summary: Pomona Unified School District urges the FCC to preserve the E‑Rate program in its current form, oppose any sunset or narrowing of eligibility, maintain socioeconomic‑based discounts, keep infrastructure and category‑one/‑two support, and avoid new screen‑time or CIPA conditions while protecting administrative simplicity. PUSD argues that E‑Rate should remain in place to cover ongoing, recurring connectivity needs; sunsetting or narrowing the program would shift costs to local districts, and low demand does not indicate the program is oversized. PUSD opposes federal conditions on E‑Rate related to screen time, parental opt‑out, and supervision, while supporting expansion of eligibility to address cybersecurity needs. The comment urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E‑Rate program, opposing sunset or cuts, limiting support to rural areas, and conditioning funding on screen‑time or other educational mandates.
